component.name: Omaroll
component.summary: A fast, beautiful image, video, and PDF viewer

description.p: Omaroll is a local-first image, video and PDF viewer for Omarchy. A picture or video opens in a viewer window that fills with it, with controls that appear when the pointer moves and the rest of its folder in a filmstrip. Opening Omaroll on its own shows the library: photos, screenshots, videos, PDFs, downloads and your own folders together, by day, source or folder.

ul.li: Search names, text in pictures and PDFs, captions, tags, albums, folders and cameras
Albums, nested tags, captions, ratings and favourites, with automatic backups, without moving your files
Video with sound, seek-bar previews, frame stepping, audio tracks, subtitles and media keys
Crop, straighten, rotate, flip and resize as copies, leaving the original unchanged
Exact duplicates and similar pictures side by side, with Undo for anything sent to Trash
Copy, drag or send files, and hand off to Omarchy's tools for trimming, annotation and conversion

description.p: Omaroll follows your Omarchy theme, palette and font as they change. Your files stay where they are, and the library is kept on your machine.

screenshot.caption: Open a picture in a quick viewer that follows your theme
Browse photos, videos and PDFs together in a local library
Preview media with navigation and file actions

description.p: A redesigned library and viewer, sections by date, and clear help when something goes wrong.

ul.li: Date sections, file-manager selection, combined filters and search fields such as tag:, camera: and in:
Seek-bar previews, Open in mpv at the current position and --start for videos
Undo for Trash, automatic backups of your organization and Save rotated copy in the viewer
Settings in sections, shortcut help on ? and F1, and Copy diagnostics in About
omaroll --set-default and --unset-default, Hyprland window rules and a man page
Faster first frames and grids, and about half the CPU for 4K playback
